## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      3 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: May 10, 2026 - Jul 25, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users report reliability problems. This points to quality gaps competitors can exploit.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _blumenkaft_, Jul 1, 2026, 1/5: "At one time this was an efficient tracker, but now it’s bloated and frustrating. They could have prioritized improving database accuracy, purging duplicate entries, or barcode reliability, but I guess that’s actual work. Instead we have a broken app where they change the icon every month and add time-wasting gamification elements that don’t even work! Lol, every day I earn a chest of ‘diamonds’ that can’t even be collected."
            2. _AB_LV_, May 10, 2026, 1/5: "Keeps crashing and I can’t connect the step counter with my garmin connect app, paid for premium membership so very disappointed"
            3. _Spieler dieses Spieles_, Jul 24, 2026, 2/5: "Normally I always calculated my meals and then simply entered them in “Quick Add”. Now that just doesn't work anymore. It always redirects me to this “speech/text” feature which is just bad. I thought it was just a bug and I uninstalled and reinstalled the app 3 times but nothing changed. Now I can no longer enter my meals, which makes the app no ​​longer usable for me. Too bad!"

## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

   **Pricing and paywall.**
      1 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Jul 22, 2026 - Jul 22, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Trixterchick_, Jul 22, 2026, 4/5: "Okay, full disclosure, when I first started using this, I disliked it so much that I stupidly canceled it and will have to renew the subscription 🙄. That's what I get for being impatient. Being post-menopausal, losing weight just almost seems impossible, and this is good for showing me my blind spots and what I may have been doing wrong. I still wish they would just show calories instead of kilajoules, because it's a hassle looking it up. I also wish that you could program it for dairy free (lactose-free is not dairy free, so that doesn't help with allergies--hence the 4 stars instead of 5. Overall, though, I can see why people like this app and since Google Health has destroyed FitBit's user-friendly interface, this is a nice, inexpensive option."
